name: cn-financing-bp
description: Build a financing business plan (融资商业计划书, BP) for a Chinese start-up raising seed, angel or Series A money: the storyline, slide-by-slide content, the numbers investors check, the financing ask and use of funds, and preparation for due diligence and term-sheet clauses. Use when asked 帮我写商业计划书, 融资 BP 怎么写, 天使轮 BP 结构, 投资人最看重什么, 估值怎么报, or write a pitch deck for Chinese investors. Produces a one-sentence positioning, a slide outline with the content and evidence for each, a metrics table, a financing plan, likely investor questions, and a list of clauses to understand before signing. Distinct from investor-pitch-deck, which follows Western conventions.
